test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following river's section was declared as National Waterway-2 in 1988?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__.

__
 
• **The Brahmaputra river with a length of 891 km between the Bangladesh border and Sadiya was declared as National Waterway No. 2 (NW-2) on 1 September 1988**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Waterways Act** came into force in 2016.

 
 
• In 1986, the Government of India created the Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) to regulate and develop inland waterways for navigation and shipping.
